mapper.select: SELECT id, fund_code, estimate_time, estimate_nav, estimate_growth_rate, previous_nav, previous_nav_date, source, source_status, status_reason, holding_coverage_rate, quote_coverage_rate, missing_quote_count, quote_time, holding_report_date, holding_report_period, input_data_version, algorithm_version, trade_date, config_release_version, config_release_checksum, estimate_config_version, estimate_config_checksum, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM fund_estimate WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND config_release_version = #{configReleaseVersion} AND config_release_checksum = #{configReleaseChecksum} ORDER BY estimate_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT id, estimate_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fund_code, config_release_version, config_release_checksum ORDER BY estimate_time DESC ) AS snapshot_rank FROM fund_estimate ), candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM ranked WHERE snapshot_rank > 1 AND estimate_time < #{cutoff} ORDER BY estimate_time LIMIT #{batchSize} ) DELETE FROM fund_estimate WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
